# Dreamy Vacations Resort, Kushalnagar, Coorg

> Dreamy Vacations is a tranquil family and group resort located in Chikkathur Village, Kushalnagar, Coorg, Karnataka, India. Offering spacious family suites, double bedrooms, outdoor swimming pool, rain dance system, and evening campfires.

## Quick Facts
- Property Type: Resort / Lodging
- Location: #51/5, Behind Chikkathur Govt School, Chikkathur Village, Kushalnagar, Kudumangalore, Karnataka 571232, India
- GPS Coordinates: 12.486260, 75.940539
- Primary Contact: +91 99029 60484
- Official Website: https://dreamyvacations1.vercel.app/
- Check-in Time: 12:00 PM
- Check-out Time: 11:00 AM

## Accommodations
- Standard Family Room: 380 sq.ft., 1 Double Bed, Ensuite Bathroom, Free Wi-Fi, Pool Access (from ₹4,084/night)
- Deluxe Family Room: 420 sq.ft., 1 Double Bed, Private Balcony overlooking pool/gardens, Wood false ceilings (from ₹4,749/night)
- Superior Deluxe Double: 320 sq.ft., 2 Double Beds, 4 Adults, Flagship ambient wood tray lighting (from ₹4,702/night)
- Triple Room: 350 sq.ft., 3 Double Beds, up to 6 Adults, ideal for groups & families (from ₹5,984/night)

## Key Facilities
- Outdoor swimming pool with filtered water and safe shallow section
- Rhythmic mist rain dance system with music
- Indoor recreation: carrom, chess, tabletop board games
- Free high-speed Wi-Fi across the property
- Ample secure free on-site parking for private vehicles and tourist buses
- Evening campfires upon request

## Proximity to Major Attractions
- Namdroling Monastery (Golden Temple Bylakuppe): 6 km (12 mins drive)
- Kaveri Nisargadhama Forest Island: 4 km (8 mins drive)
- Dubare Elephant Camp: 14 km (20 mins drive)
- Harangi Dam & Reservoir: 9 km (15 mins drive)
- Chiklihole Reservoir: 16 km (22 mins drive)
- Madikeri Town Centre, Abbey Falls, Raja's Seat: 30 km (45 mins scenic drive)
